sloka: त्वच्छोकविमुखो रामो देवि सत्येन मे शपे ।रामे दुःखाभिपन्ने च लक्ष्मणः परितप्यते ।। ५.३८.५०।।।।
transliteration: tvacchokavimukho rāmo devi satyena me śape ।rāme duḥkhābhipanne ca lakṣmaṇaḥ paritapyate ।। 5.38.50।।।।

translations.english: "O godlike lady Rama is not averse to your misery. On my word this is true. Rama is immersed in sorrow. Even Lakshmana wails.
